spans.s:
n. (-नं)
A herd of cows, a multitude or number of cattle, especially if considered as property.
m. (-नः)
A large headed arrow.
E.
गो a cow, and धन wealth.

f. (-धा)
1 A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, to prevent its being injured by the bowstring.
2 An iguana, either the Gosamp or the alligator.
E.
गुध to surround, affixes अङ् and टाप्; see गोधिक.

f. (-का)
Cissus pedata.
E.
कन् added to the next.

f. (-दी)
A plant, (Cissus pedata.)
E.
गोधा, and पद for पाद a foot, affix ङीष्, the root being compared to an alligator's foot.

m. (-धिः)
1 The forehead.
2 The Gangetic alligator.
3 An iguana.
E.
गो the eye or water, and धा to possess, with कि aff.

f. (-का)
1 The Gangetic alligator.
2 The iguana.
E.
कन् with the fem. form added to गोधा.

m. (-जः)
The iguana.
E.
गोधा an alligator, and आत्मज offspring, here used to imply diminution: so गोधिकापुत्र, &c.

The orange.
3 The name of a drug.
E.
गुध to surround, and ऊम Uṇādi aff.

n. (-र्लं)
Wheat flour.
E.
गोधूम, and चूर्ण powder.

n. (-वं)
Sour paste.
E.
गोधूम, and सम्भव produced.

f. (-लिः)
A period of the day, in the hot season when the sun is half risen; in the cold and dewy seasons, when the sun is full but mild; and in the three other seasons, sunset.
E.
गो, and धूलि dust.

f. (-नुः)
A milch cow.
E.
गो a cow, and धेनु the same.

m. (-रः)
A guardian, a protector, a preserver.
